counterfactual_missing_items: No raw span explicitly states 'Tuberous Sclerosis Complex' as the final diagnosis
No mention of additional major TSC features such as retinal hamartomas or renal angiomyolipomas
No raw evidence of INI1 loss to support rhabdoid tumor
decisive_items: TSC1 gene mutation (15 exon c.1690 G > T, p.E564*)
Subcortical tubers in white matter of frontal lobes
response.rationale: R4 is champion because it uniquely integrates the TSC1 mutation, cardiac rhabdomyoma, subcortical tubers, and depigmented spots; R5's histologic atypia is nonspecific and lacks genetic/syndromic support, while C1's SEGA is contradicted by high mitotic activity and atypical location.

rejected.why: Correlated restatement of R4; adds only etiology already present in R4's raw support.
Correlated restatement of R5; adds no new raw evidence beyond R5's cytologic atypia.
Neurocutaneous Melanosis is unsupported; depigmented spots are hypopigmented, not melanocytic nevi, and no raw support.
Correlated restatement of R3; depigmented spots do not support neurocutaneous melanosis.
Rhabdomyoma is a component of TSC, not the overall diagnosis; lacks genetic and brain findings.
Correlated restatement of R1; adds only anatomy already in R1's raw support.
SEGA has no raw support; imaging mass is nonspecific and histology contradicts SEGA.
SEGA of posterior fossa is unsupported by raw histology (high mitoses/Ki67) and location; imaging mass alone is not diagnostic.
